attempts.summary: Built the point-to-point chain node3 -- node1(VyOS) -- node2(OPNsense) -- node4, configured node1 to permit+log tcp/23 traffic from node3 toward node4 and node2 to refuse+log the same flow, and verified a single connection attempt from node3 produces a matching permit/refuse log pair on node1 and node2 (identical source/dest IP, port, and IP ID, same timestamp). Then completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all four nodes, proving changed boot identity and full recovery of interfaces, routes, and firewall config, and re-verified the same permit/refuse behavior and log pairing after all reboots.
